settings.title: Shipping & Delivery
settings.subheading: Orders processed within 1–2 business days. Typical delivery in 3–7 business days across India with real-time tracking updates.

settings.title: 1–2 Day Processing
settings.text: All orders are verified, securely packed, and dispatched within 1–2 business days from our fulfillment center.

settings.title: 3–7 Day Delivery
settings.text: Typical delivery takes 3–7 business days depending on location and regional courier network accessibility.

settings.title: Transparent Shipping
settings.text: Shipping charges, special promotions, and free delivery thresholds are calculated and shown clearly at checkout.

settings.heading: 1. Order Processing & Dispatch
settings.body: Orders are processed and prepared for dispatch within 1–2 business days (Monday through Saturday, excluding national holidays). Once your package is handed over to our courier partner, you will receive an automated shipping confirmation with a live tracking link.

settings.heading: 2. Delivery Timelines by Region
settings.body:
• Metro Cities (Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune): 2–4 business days.
• Tier 2 and Tier 3 Cities: 3–5 business days.
• Remote and Regional Locations: 5–7 business days.

settings.heading: 3. Shipping Charges & Tracking
settings.body: Applicable shipping fees are clearly displayed at checkout before you complete payment. Free shipping is provided on all multi-item bundle orders. Customers receive regular SMS and email notifications regarding order status and transit milestones.

settings.heading: 4. Damaged or Delayed Shipments
settings.body: If your order has not arrived within the estimated 3–7 business day window, or if a package arrives damaged in transit, please contact our support team at support@purelane.com or via WhatsApp (+91 9930 123 234) with your order number for swift resolution.

settings.default_body: We partner with leading tier-1 express logistics providers across India to ensure safe, spill-proof delivery of your homecare essentials.
